title: Grug Walks Normal Now
prompt: A normal South Park-like cutout walk using four discrete character poses. Horizontal travel, background parallax, speech, and mouth cues remain full-rate.

beats.narration: Grug now walks like a normal cutout citizen. Four poses. Eight frames per pose. Lean back. Step. Lean forward. Step.
